headline: Linn of Mercy Reignites as Gutter Flags Return to Wardens
war_summary: Since our last edition the Gutter has reverted wholly to Warden hands, its seven posts flying Warden colors once more after the Colonial seizure of The Parras, though the ground there has gone quiet in the past two hours. The day's heaviest fighting has shifted to the Linn of Mercy, where twenty-two base actions in the past day — the latest logged minutes before this edition — center on Rotdust and Lathair, and casualty rates accelerate sharply on both sides, the Warden toll running steeper. Stonecradle remains in play, five actions in the last two hours around The Reach, Buckler Sound and The Heir's Knife leaving its nine posts split six Colonial to two Warden with one in no-man's-land. Fort Ember on Fisherman's Row has seen fresh movement, and the row now stands wholly in Colonial colors. The Weathered Expanse holds six Warden to three Colonial, Crow's Nest still its busiest point, though its firing has cooled. Farranac Coast logged fresh Warden captures near Transient Valley, yet the coast remains nine Colonial posts to two. Along Callahan's Passage casualty rates climb steeply on both sides even without recorded base actions. No victor is declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
